comparison.objective: Snap a full sharps-container lid shut before transport; not tune a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Container stabilization, distributed lid closure/snap engagement, and carrying versus hex-key operation, collar rotation, torque-bounded locking, and dynamic iteration.
comparison.success_condition: Title implies final lid fully secured before moving to pickup bin; candidate requires two safe cycles and a witness-tested retained setting.
comparison.reason: Closure-before-transport is clearly different from calibration, though the record omits latch checks, spill/exposure rules, force thresholds, and spec versions.
